headline: Google sues alleged Chinese cybercrime operation that used AI to send scam texts
snapshot: The tech giant said a group called "Outsider Enterprise" used AI to scam hundreds of thousands of victims, sending 2.5 million text messages over a span of two weeks. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
